pages.text: Ten distinct, modest accessories. Curios 5.14.1+ adds 3 dedicated Stellar Ornament slots; right-click to equip. Identical ornaments do not stack. Without Curios, one ornament in your offhand is active. Inventory, main-hand and cosmetic slots are inactive.$(br2)Each recipe uses 4 star ingots, 2 auxiliary items and a vanilla core item. Recipes unlock on obtaining star ingots. Normal vanilla/Curios death-drop rules apply.

pages.title: Starfall Amulet
pages.text: Gain +10% star energy, additive with talents. Still requires a full stellar set; capacity unchanged.

pages.title: Orbit Ring
pages.text: +5% additive astral sword damage; snapshotted at wave launch.

pages.title: Starwing Brooch
pages.text: Take 20% less fall damage. No flight or duplicate stacking.

pages.title: Crescent Earring
pages.text: Grants night vision; fades within 11s after removal. Never removes other night vision sources.

pages.title: Dawnstar Crown
pages.text: +2 max health (1 heart); removed on unequip.

pages.title: Meteor Pendant
pages.text: Monster kills have a 20% chance to repair 2 main-hand durability. One attempt/10s; skips Mending by default.

pages.title: Astral Compass
pages.text: +10% mining speed for ores. No extra drops or x-ray.

pages.title: Starlight Insignia
pages.text: +0.05 knockback resistance; duplicates do not stack.

pages.title: Twilight Talisman
pages.text: At hunger 16+, after 5s out of combat, heal 1 HP every 10s. No lethal-damage immunity.
